jobs.title: Software Engineer with an Affinity for Livestock Farming
jobs.description:
Your job

Are you a software engineer who looks beyond just code? Do you have a practical background or strong affinity with livestock farming and do you want to use your technical skills to make the agricultural sector smarter and more sustainable? Then we are looking for you.

What will you do?

As a software engineer, you will work on innovative digital solutions for livestock farming. Think of simulation programs to perform scenario analyses, applications for data collection and analysis and management systems for livestock farms (digital twins). You translate practical questions into smart software and work closely with colleagues from both IT and agricultural background.

Your Tasks

developing and maintaining software (e.g. web applications, dashboards or other software tools);
translating the practical needs of researchers and consultants into technical solutions;
collaborate with researchers, advisors and end users;
testing and improving existing systems;
thinking about innovations within the sector.

Your team

Within the Animal Farming Systems department, you will work together with a research team of 35 highly motivated project leaders, researchers and project assistants. We are known for our innovative and integrated approach in designing and evaluating the sustainability of animal farming systems. You will work together with colleagues from your own team and colleagues from other Wageningen Livestock Research departments or WUR research institutes in a project team.

This is where you will work

You will work on the greenest and most innovative campus in the Netherlands, and at a university that has been voted the "best university" in the Netherlands 20 times and is also seen worldwide as the best university in the agri-food domain.

Your qualities

You have analytical thinking skills and a solution-oriented mindset. In addition, you have good communication skills and a proactive attitude.

You Also Have

a completed bachelor focused on computer science, animal husbandry or agricultural entrepreneurship;
experience in developing software with e.g. C# or Python;
affinity with and interest in the livestock sector.

In our international working environment, communication is increasingly in English. This position involves language level (https://www.coe.int/en/web/common-european-framework-reference-languages/table-1-cefr-3.3-common-reference-levels-global-scale) C1. If you do not yet have this level, we will of course help you and you can contact our language center Wageningen in'to Language (https://www.wur.nl/nl/onderwijs-opleidingen/wageningen-into-languages.htm).

You can see that there are plenty of challenges for you. These challenges can also be seen as development opportunities. So if you do not yet have the track record required in the vacancy, but do have solid work experience, we would also like to invite you to apply.

We offer

Wageningen University & Research offers excellent terms of employment (https://www.wur.nl/en/jobs/conditions-of-employment). A few highlights from our Collective Labour Agreement include:

working hours that can be discussed and arranged so that they allow for the best possible work-life balance;
sabbatical leave, study leave, and partially paid parental leave;
there is a strong focus on vitality and you can make use of the sports facilities available on campus for a small fee;
a fixed year-end bonus of 8,3%;
excellent pension scheme.

In addition to these first-rate employee benefits, you will of course receive a good salary. We offer, depending on your experience, a competitive gross salary of between € 3,381.- and € 5,132.- for a full-time working week of 36 hours, in accordance with the CLA Wageningen Research (scale 8/9). Additionally, for this role a contract of 32 to 36 hours can be discussed. We initially offer a one-year contract, with the possibility of renewal subject to satisfactory performance and depending on the organisation’s financial situation.

We encourage development and internal mobility within our organisation. Our recruitment and selection policy sets out the conditions that apply specifically to you as a (former) employee. If you have any questions, we are happy to help.

Coming from abroad

WUR welcomes applications from international candidates. However, for applicants for this specific position from outside the EU/EFTA zone, immigration restrictions may apply based on Dutch and EU immigration laws. Such candidates may be eligible for an “ orientation year ” in the Netherlands or a visa as a “ knowledge migrant ”.

Wageningen University & Research is the university and research centre for life sciences. The themes we deal with are relevant to everyone around the world and Wageningen, therefore, has a large international community and a lot to offer to international employees.

Because we expect you to work and live in the Netherlands our team of advisors on Dutch immigration procedures will help you with the visa application procedures for yourself and, if applicable, for your family. If you come with a partner, we offer a Dual Career group program organized by our Welcome Center (https://wcfv.nl/en/home/global/our-services/happy-landing-and-living/). This program helps your partner to get familiar with the Dutch culture, labour market and assists your partner to find a job.

Feeling welcome also has everything to do with being well informed. Wageningen University & Research's International Community (https://www.wur.nl/en/jobs/expats-new-international-staff) page contains practical information about what we can do to support international employees coming to Wageningen. Furthermore, our Welcome Center can assist you with any additional advice and information about for example housing, opening a bank account or schooling. Finally, certain categories of international staff may be eligible for a tax exemption on a part of their salary during the first five years in the Netherlands.

Important information

For more information about the position, please contact ir. Frank Gort, Head of the Department of Animal Production Systems, via phone number: +31 681028847 or via email: frank.gort@wur.nl (mailto:frank.gort@wur.nl).

Questions about the procedure? Get in touch with Dax Teunissen, Corporate Recruiter, via email: recruitment.asg@wur.nl (mailto:recruitment.asg@wur.nl).

Ready to apply?

Click on the application button next to the vacancy on our website. Only applications submitted through our website will be considered.

You can apply up to and including Sunday September 27, 2026
. Internal candidates are preferred to apply before August 1, 2026.

Applications are reviewed regularly. Therefore, the position may be filled before the stated closing date.

Welcome, safe, and valued

Wageningen University & Research (WUR) highly values diversity and inclusion because we believe that different insights lead to innovative solutions. We create a work environment where everyone feels welcome, safe, and appreciated, regardless of background, identity, or experience. Together, we are building a culture where everyone's unique contribution adds to the success of our organization.

We are

The mission of Wageningen University & Research is “To explore the potential of nature to improve the quality of life”. Under the banner Wageningen University & Research, Wageningen University and the specialised research institutes of the Wageningen Research Foundation have joined forces in contributing to finding solutions to important questions in the domain of healthy food and living environment. With its roughly 30 branches, 7,600 employees (6,700 fte) and 13,100 students and over 150,000 participants to WUR’s Life Long Learning, Wageningen University & Research is one of the leading organisations in its domain. The unique Wageningen approach lies in its integrated approach to issues and the collaboration between different disciplines.

Read the 5 reasons (https://www.wur.nl/en/Jobs/Why-choose-WUR.htm) why your future colleagues enjoy working at WUR and watch the video below to get an idea of our green campus!

We will recruit for the vacancy ourselves, so no employment agencies please. However, sharing in your network is appreciated.

jobs.title: Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d) – Cloud & Microservices / C# / .NET
jobs.description:
Tiere. Technologie. Zukunft

Sano steht für nachhaltige Tierernährung – von Mineralfutter und Kälbermilch bis zu Spezialprodukten für Rinder und Schweine. Unser Produktportfolio ist so vielfältig wie die Landwirtschaft selbst. Als Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d) wirst du Teil eines Familienunternehmens mit über 1.000 Mitarbeitenden weltweit. Ein Unternehmen, das seit Jahrzehnten weiß, worauf es ankommt: gesunde Tiere, nachhaltige Prozesse – und IT, die das möglich macht.

Was dich erwartet? Kurze Entscheidungswege, ein Team mit echtem Antrieb und eine Branche, die Nachhaltigkeit nicht nur predigt, sondern lebt.

Hier bist du gefragt - deine Aufgaben

Als Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d) technische Verantwortung für unsere Plattform übernehmen und aktiv mitgestalten, wie unsere Software in Zukunft aufgebaut ist.
Sowohl selbstständig als auch im Team spannende Lösungen erarbeiten, die bereits heute in der Landwirtschaft eingesetzt und von dir kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt werden.
Mit deinem Gespür für den richtigen Code Struktur in komplexe Systeme bringen, unsere Cloud-Plattform gestalten und dabei die langfristige Tragfähigkeit unserer Lösungen im Blick behalten.
Standards, Schnittstellen und technische Leitplanken definieren, neue Technologien bewerten und fundierte Architekturentscheidungen treffen.
Mit deinem Blick für das Wesentliche moderne Architekturansätze wie Microservices oder API-basierte Systeme sinnvoll einbringen.
Last, but not least beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unserer DevOps- und CI/CD-Strukturen supporten.

Das bringst du mit – dein Profil

Idealerweise eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium mit IT-Bezug – was zählt: Du brennst für IT und Softwarearchitektur
Ein Muss: Berufspraxis als Softwarearchitekt (m/w/d), Solution Architect (m/w/d) oder Lead Developer (m/w/d)
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in C# und .NET (Core/6/7/8)
Sehr gutes Verständnis moderner Softwarearchitekturen (Microservices, Event-Driven, API-Design, Messaging) sowie fundiertes Know-how in Security-Konzepten
Erfahrung in Cloud-Plattformen (AWS, Azure oder Google Cloud), in Container-Technologien (Docker, Kubernetes) und in Datenplattformen, Datenbanken sowie IoT-Architekturen
Kenntnisse in DevOps, CI/CD und Infrastructure as Code (z. B. Terraform, Bicep, GitOps) sowie Expertise im Monitoring, Logging und Tracing Spaß daran, technische Themen verständlich zu vermitteln und in (komplexen) Architekturen zu denken

Deine Vorteile bei Sano

Gute Arbeit, guter Verdienst: attraktives Gehaltspaket
Werkzeug, das begeistert: moderne Ausstattung für deinen Arbeitsalltag
Zeit für dich: 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr
Beruf trifft Leben: Flexible Modelle zur Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf – damit wir dich in jeder Lebensphase begleiten
Hier bist du richtig: ein zukunftssicheres Umfeld, das auf dich wartet
Rundum gut versorgt: arbeitgeberfinanzierte Krankenzusatzversicherung & betriebliche Altersvorsorge
Sattel auf, Zukunft an: Business Bike
Gemeinsam mehr erleben: besondere Teamevents, die verbinden
Kleine Aufmerksamkeiten, große Wirkung: spannende Mitarbeitergeschenke
Wissen, das wächst: die Sano Akademie – dein Ort für Entwicklung und Weiterbildung

jobs.title: Azure Cloud Engineer (gn)
jobs.description:
Job Function

Services

Warum SoftwareOne?

SoftwareOne ist ein globaler Anbieter für Software- und Cloud-Lösungen. Mit einer Präsenz in über 70 Ländern und mehr als 12.000 Mitarbeitenden unterstützen wir Unternehmen dabei, ihre Software-Investitionen zu optimieren, Anwendungen zu modernisieren und das volle Potenzial von Cloud, Data und AI zu erschließen.

Was uns ausmacht, sind die Menschen bei SoftwareOne. Wir ermöglichen Zusammenarbeit über Ländergrenzen hinweg, fördern kontinuierliches Lernen und schaffen Raum für Entwicklung in einer sich ständig wandelnden Technologielandschaft. Ob dein Fokus auf Technologie, Customer Success oder Business Operations liegt – deine Ideen zählen und dein Beitrag macht einen Unterschied.

Werde Teil eines globalen Teams, in dem du deine Fähigkeiten weiterentwickelst, mit führenden Technologien arbeitest und echten Mehrwert für unsere Kunden schaffst.

Die Rolle

Suchst du eine Rolle, in der du dich tief auf komplexe Microsoft-Azure-Infrastrukturen spezialisieren und technische Entscheidungen prägen kannst?
Möchtest du nicht nur „Tickets abarbeiten“, sondern langfristig Kundenumgebungen mitgestalten, modernisieren und sicherer machen?
Bist du bereit in Enterprise Azure Umgebungen unserer Kunden der wirklich Wirkung zu erzielen?

Praktische Informationen

Standort:
Bundesweit, Deutschland | Arbeitsmodell:
Hybrid / Remote mit Vor-Ort-Einsätzen | Sprachen
:
Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse | Umfang:
Vollzeit | Rufbereitschaft und gelegentliche Vor-Ort-Einsätze

Unser Team Hybrid Managed Service stellt die Leistungsfähigkeit der IT-Infrastrukturen unserer Kunden sicher. In maßgeschneiderten Setups übernehmen wir den Betrieb verschiedener Infrastrukturdienste und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter. Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen in den Bereichen Data Center, Storage, Backup, Windows, Linux, Virtualisierung sowie im Infrastruktur Support.

Als Azure Cloud Engineer (gn) übernimmst du technische Verantwortung für geschäftskritische Managed-Service-Umgebungen auf Microsoft Azure. Du stellst den stabilen, sicheren Betrieb sicher, analysierst Störungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Cloud-, Infrastruktur- und Entwicklungsteams nachhaltige Verbesserungen.

Deine Aufgaben

Betrieb, Monitoring und Optimierung komplexer Microsoft-Azure-Infrastrukturen
Analyse und Behebung anspruchsvoller Incidents sowie Ableitung nachhaltiger Maßnahmen
Automatisierung wiederkehrender Aufgaben mit PowerShell, Bash und Azure Runbooks
Administration von Azure-Netzwerken, virtuellen Maschinen, Datenbanken, Identitäten, Berechtigungen und Richtlinien
Weiterentwicklung von Monitoring, Logging, Dokumentation und Knowledge Base
Mitarbeit an Infrastructure-as-Code-Themen, insbesondere Terraform
Teilnahme an Vor-Ort-Terminen, Supporteinsätzen und 24/7-Rufbereitschaft

Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten

Du bringst eine Eigenverantwortliche, proaktive und strukturierte Arbeitsweise mit und die Bereitschaft, dich in neue Technologien und angrenzende Applikations- oder Web-Service-Themen einzuarbeiten. Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb komplexer Microsoft-Azure-Umgebungen mit und hast Erfahrung in folgenden Bereichen:

Technische Schwerpunkte

Azure Infrastructure: Subscriptions, Management Groups, VMs, Netzwerke, Firewalls, VPN, Application Gateway, Private Endpoints und DNS
Azure Operations: Resource Health, Monitoring, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Update Manager und Maintenance Configurations
Datenbanken und Plattformdienste wie Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Web Apps, Container Apps und Container Registry
Identity & Security: Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Azure Policy, Privileged Identity Management und AD-Synchronisierung
Grundkenntnisse in Azure DevOps, insbesondere Repositories, Pipelines und Service Connections

Betriebssysteme und Automatisierung

Erfahrung mit Windows Server sowie Grundkenntnisse in Linux, idealerweise Red Hat Enterprise Linux oder Ubuntu
Scripting- und Automatisierungskenntnisse mit PowerShell und Bash
Kenntnisse in Kusto Query Language, JSON, ARM Templates sowie Interesse an Terraform
Kenntnisse in Active Directory Domain Services und DNS

Das haben wir zu bieten

Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind unser wichtigstes Kapital und wir setzen alles daran, dass du dich bei uns wohl fühlst:  

Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten  
30 Urlaubstage sowie die Option auf ein Sabbatical  
Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sowie persönliches Coaching und Beratung  
Engagement für Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit durch unsere DEIB-Strategie und Initiativen  
Gesundheits- und Sportangebote (z.B. Wellpass) sowie Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge  
Attraktive Zusatzleistungen wie Mitarbeitendenaktien, Empfehlungsprogramm und Corporate Benefits  
Angenehme Arbeitskultur mit freiem Dresscode und strukturiertem Onboarding inklusive Buddy 

Alle weiteren Benefits unter:  hier  

Interessiert?

Dann bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf und wenigen Klicks über unser Online-Formular! Es ist kein Anschreiben nötig. 

Inklusion und Unterstützung

SoftwareOne lädt Menschen jeglicher Herkunft und mit unterschiedlichen Fähigkeiten herzlich dazu ein, sich bei uns zu bewerben. Solltest du während des Bewerbungsprozesses Anpassungen benötigen, sende uns bitte eine E-Mail an hier . Zudem laden wir Berufs-Wiedereinsteiger ein, die nach einer geplanten Auszeit in die Berufswelt zurückzukehren möchte, unser SOAR Programm zu erkunden.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you a talented Senior Software Engineer looking for an exciting new challenge? STS Defence is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our dynamic Programmes Division in Gosport.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in the design, development, and implementation of advanced software systems that support our defence programmes. Your expertise will contribute to the success of critical projects, ensuring that we continue to meet and exceed the expectations of our clients.

STS Defence is a leading provider of innovative and mission-critical solutions for the defence sector. With a strong commitment to excellence and a focus on cutting-edge technology, we deliver superior solutions that enhance the capabilities of our clients.

The post will provide technical leadership on software projects for key stakeholders and on software development activities undertaken by the company. This includes responsibility for managing code and quality reviews to ensure relevant quality standards are met across the software team.

The Senior Software Engineer will also assist in support of wider business objectives exploring new technologies for product creation, development and R&D to grow our software development capability stream; and provide support to existing software projects as required.

Duties

The Senior Software Engineer will be responsible for co-ordination of day to day software development in a small team
Designing and implementing software changes through change control process as part of spiral development
Continuous improvement of Software Engineering capabilities, maintaining a leading edge capability
Leading the planning, delivery and assurance of software work packages and ensuring software engineering process and best practice followed
Oversight, direction and guidance to the allocated project team members, through the planning and delivery of installation tasks and projects

jobs.description:

Job title:
Mid-Level Full Stack WEB Developer (.NET)

About BSC

The Barcelona Supercomputing Center - Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC-CNS) is the leading supercomputing center in Spain. It houses MareNostrum, one of the most powerful supercomputers in Europe, was a founding and hosting member of the former European HPC infrastructure PRACE (Partnership for Advanced Computing in Europe), and is now hosting entity for EuroHPC JU, the Joint Undertaking that leads large-scale investments and HPC provision in Europe. The mission of BSC is to research, develop and manage information technologies in order to facilitate scientific progress. BSC combines HPC service provision and R&D into both computer and computational science (life, earth and engineering sciences) under one roof, and currently has over 1000 staff from 60 countries.

Look At The BSC Experience

BSC-CNS YouTube Channel

Let's stay connected with BSC Folks!

We are particularly interested for this role in the strengths and lived experiences of women and underrepresented groups to help us avoid perpetuating biases and oversights in science and IT research. In instances of equal merit, the incorporation of the under-represented sex will be favoured.

We promote Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, fostering an environment where each and every one of us is appreciated for who we are, regardless of our differences.

If you consider that you do not meet all the requirements, we encourage you to continue applying for the job offer. We value diversity of experiences and skills, and you could bring unique perspectives to our team.

Context And Mission

We are looking for a Mid-Level Full Stack Developer with experience in .NET to join an internal platform used for time tracking and reporting in audit processes.

The selected candidate will be responsible for maintaining, improving, and supporting the application.

Key Duties

Develop end-to-end features using .NET Core / .NET 6+ on the backend and Razor Views + HTML on the frontend
Participate in architecture design and technical decision-making
Contribute to code quality improvements, code reviews, and best practices
Integrate REST APIs and work with SQL databases
Provide support to the financial justification team regarding the platform

Requirements

Education
Degree in Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or similar

Essential Knowledge and Professional Experience
2–4 years of experience with C# and .NET Core / .NET 6+
Experience with Entity Framework and SQL Server
Experience working with Razor Views
Strong knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery
Experience with web deployment (Kestrel/HTTPS) and SMTP/authentication setup
Working fluency in Spanish and English is required, Catalan will be a plus.

Additional Knowledge and Professional Experience
Understanding of REST APIs
Nice to have:
ASP.NET Identity
Quartz.NET for scheduled jobs
QuestPDF or similar PDF generation libraries
EPPlus for Excel/CSV exports
SMTP / automated email sending
Serilog

Competences
Autonomy & Proactivity: Ability to work independently and take initiative in development tasks.
Technical Ownership: End-to-end responsibility for development, testing, and maintenance.
Problem Solving: Diagnose and resolve issues.
Clean Code & Best Practices: Experience with .NET best practices, design patterns, and Git.
Communication & Collaboration: Clear communication with technical and non-technical staff

Conditions

The position will be located at BSC within the Management Department
We offer a full-time contract (35h/week), a good working environment, a highly stimulating environment with state-of-the-art infrastructure, flexible working hours, extensive training plan, restaurant tickets, private health insurance, support to the relocation procedures
Duration: Open-ended contract due to technical and scientific activities linked to the project and budget duration
Holidays: 22 days of holidays + 6 personal days + 24th and 31st of December per our collective agreement
Salary: we offer a competitive salary commensurate with the qualifications and experience of the candidate and according to the cost of living in Barcelona
Starting date: ASAP

Applications procedure and process

All applications must be submitted via the BSC website and contain:

A full CV in English including contact details
A cover/motivation letter with a statement of interest in English, clearly specifying for which specific area and topics the applicant wishes to be considered. Additionally, two references for further contacts must be included. Applications without this document will not be considered.

Development of the recruitment process

The selection will be carried out through a competitive examination system ("Concurso-Oposición"). The recruitment process consists of two phases:

Curriculum Analysis: Evaluation of previous experience and/or scientific history, degree, training, and other professional information relevant to the position. - 40 points
Interview phase: The highest-rated candidates at the curriculum level will be invited to the interview phase, conducted by the corresponding department and Human Resources. In this phase, technical competencies, knowledge, skills, and professional experience related to the position, as well as the required personal competencies, will be evaluated. - 60 points. A minimum of 30 points out of 60 must be obtained to be eligible for the position.

The recruitment panel will be composed of at least three people, ensuring at least 25% representation of women.

In accordance with OTM-R principles, a gender-balanced recruitment panel is formed for each vacancy at the beginning of the process. After reviewing the content of the applications, the panel will begin the interviews, with at least one technical and one administrative interview. At a minimum, a personality questionnaire as well as a technical exercise will be conducted during the process.

The panel will make a final decision, and all individuals who participated in the interview phase will receive feedback with details on the acceptance or rejection of their profile.

At BSC, we seek continuous improvement in our recruitment processes. For any suggestions or comments/complaints about our recruitment processes, please contact recruitment@bsc.es.

For more information, please follow this link.

Deadline

The vacancy will remain open until a suitable candidate has been hired. Applications will be regularly reviewed and potential candidates will be contacted.

OTM-R principles for selection processes

BSC-CNS is committed to the principles of the Code of Conduct for the Recruitment of Researchers of the European Commission and the Open, Transparent and Merit-based Recruitment principles (OTM-R). This is applied for any potential candidate in all our processes, for example by creating gender-balanced recruitment panels and recognizing career breaks etc.

BSC-CNS is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or any other basis protected by applicable state or local law.

jobs.title: Gametech Innovation Developer
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU WILL BE WORKING ON

The Gametech Innovation team
is a specialized group of developers focused on empowering Gameloft’s game teams to create better games through innovative technological solutions. We focus on Unity and Unreal engines, developing tools and systems that span a wide range of game development needs.

As a Mid-Level Developer
within the team, you will manage feature delivery and support the technical stability of our tools and systems, contributing to the full lifecycle of each solution.

What It Means On a Daily Basis

Own features or subsystems end-to-end, from benchmarking existing solutions and prototyping alternatives through to implementing and shipping the final tool to game teams
Write maintainable, self-explanatory code in C++ and C# within Unreal and Unity engines
Debug and profile tools and systems across engines and target platforms (console, PC, mobile) so they stay reliable in production
Maintain and extend the team's CI/CD and build pipelines so new tool versions reach game teams continuously
Use AI coding assistants in your daily workflow, experiment with new approaches and technologies, and propose the incremental improvements worth industrialising

What Success Will Look Like

In your first three months, you will be at ease in the team's codebase and delivering fixes and features on existing tools with limited guidance. From there, you will own a feature or subsystem end-to-end, you will propose improvements to tools and workflows on your own initiative and become a technical point of contact for the game teams we support.

Who You Would Be Working With

You will be reporting to our Gametech Innovation Manager, and collaborate very closely with other Developers from the Gametech Innovation team across multiple studios worldwide, including Paris, Montreal, Bucharest, and others, offering opportunities to collaborate with colleagues from diverse backgrounds and perspectives. Day to day you will work with game programmers, technical artists and producers on Gameloft's game teams internationally.

Your recruitment journey

First interview An initial discussion to explore how the role aligns with your background and to address your main questions.
Test You will be given a case study to complete.
Second interview A technical interview focused on presenting your test and discussing your approach, reasoning, and methodologies in more depth.
Final interview A conversation to discuss your experience, vision, and how you approach game technology topics at a broader level.

Where this role can take you

This role can be a stepping stone toward a more senior position within the Gametech Innovation team, or toward specialising in a particular area such as engine, pipeline or platform technology. Internal training and mentoring from the team's senior developers are available, and internal mobility across teams and studios is possible through Gameloft's Talent Move programme.

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Solid proficiency with Unreal Engine or Unity; and in C++ and C#
Practical use of AI coding assistants in your day-to-day development work
Good debugging and profiling skills across multiple systems, together with the ability to write clean, maintainable and self-explanatory code
Working knowledge of CI/CD and build pipelines

Who You Are

Naturally curious you enjoy digging into unfamiliar problems and exploring new engines, tools and approaches
Solution-driven you turn ambiguous, poorly defined requests into workable technical paths, treat constraints as problems to solve, and propose improvements beyond your assigned scope to keep the team moving forward

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

Permanent contract, full-time employment with comprehensive Social Benefits.
25 vacation days per year + Birthday day off.
Private medical health insurance.
Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card.
Free language courses.
Work-from-home hybrid model.
Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package.

Life at
Gameloft

Our Barcelona studio offers real career development opportunities and a positive working environment in a centrally located office. We value supportive working conditions and a balanced work-life approach, and our teams work together with a collaborative mindset.

Ready to level up your career? Apply now with your CV in English.
